name: New World - the ideal world -
detailed_description:
*This text uses machine translation.

--- This world is crazy.

This is the story of a cute ASCII art character living in a harsh world.

A simple command-based RPG.

ASCII Art charactor is from 2chan, but knowledge of 2chan is not required.

Only Japanese is supported.

★★This Game Summary★★

１．No humans appear in this game.

２．Estimated time to complete the project is approximately 20 hours.

３．It is a turn-based command battle RPG.

４．It includes mechanical and magical elements.

５．It has an atmosphere similar to RPG Maker2000.

６．symbol encounter.

７．There is little time to spend on increase.

８．Character performance can be customized.

９．It contains a lot of MiniGame.

１０．Save can be done anywhere.

１１．It contains a few grotesque elements.

１３．It does not contain any sexy elements.

１４．You can set the difficulty of the game.

　　　Λ Λ　

　　(*ﾟヮﾟ)⊃ I want you to understand!!

　～/U /

　　U U

（´∀｀）ＳＴＯＲＹ

The country where the girl called Sira lives was a dictatorship of fear.

Her parents were killed by this country when she was very young.

As an adult, Sira hides her desire for revenge against emperor and begins to look for someone to help her kill him.

―――Unaware that there is a great secret in this world.

（・∀・）Recommended Players

・Like a world with both machines and magic.

・Want to play RPGs that include mini-games.

・Like cute characters.

・Like to see the harsh world.

・Like ASCII Art charactor.

・Like to read conversational texts.

・Want to play combat that makes full use of status effect.

・Want to customize character performance.

・Don't want to spend a lot of time strengthening their characters.

・Like the atmosphere of RPG Maker2000.

（´・ω・`）Not Recommended Players

・None of the items under Recommended player are applicable.

・Not comfortable with the loss of body parts or the element of bloodshed.

・Want to complete the game in a short time.

・Want to experience a peaceful story.

・Want to play games with beautiful graphics.

・Not good at old interfaces.

・Do not like games created by RPG Maker.

■ Battle System

Almost all enemies have some characteristics, and bosses have their own weaknesses.

The difficulty level of the battles varies greatly depending on whether you are able to notice the weaknesses or not.

If you set the difficulty level to basic, you can clear

■ Mini Games

In this work, mini-games are sometimes interspersed along the way.

There are a wide variety of mini-games, but even those who are not good at them have a remedy to clear them.

■ Badge System

In this work, you can obtain a lot of equipment called Badge.

By equipping badges, you can use skills and raise or lower the value of your abilities.

Customize your character in your own way, and create your own strategy to fight.

■ Party System

The game is a four-person party, but there are more than four companions.

The party has the concept of a vanguard and a rear guard, and companions assigned to the rear guard can support the pair.

Depending on the combination, cooperative techniques can also be used.

■ Sub Contents

The protagonist of this work works to solve the problems of the inhabitants.

Therefore, he sometimes receives requests for work.

By completing the requests, he can obtain items that will advance his adventure and play mini-games.

■ Difficulty Setting

The game can be completed with a minimum number of battles, but there are three difficulty levels to accommodate other types of play.

The difficulty level can be changed at any time.

・Basic

For people who want to complete the required battles only.

For people who are not used to RPGs.

・Normal

For people who have played RPGs before.

For people who are confused about the difficulty level selection.

・Hard

For those who want to gain a lot of combat experience and fight strong bosses.
